title: Sare Hussain Sakina ki goud me aaja
body:
SAAR-E-HUSSAIN SAKINA KI GOUD MEIN AAJA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAAN LETA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
KHARDI HAI HAATAO KO PEHLAE GHAM ZADA DHUKIYA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAN LETA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
WHO HASKEY KEHTA HAI DEKHO TO KAISI ULFAT HAI
SUNA HAI SHAH KO TUMSE BADI MOHABBAT THI
TUMHARE HATH MEIN AB MERI LAAJ HAI BABA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAN LETA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
HAMESHA BAAT SAKINA KI APNI MAANI
HAMARI BAAT KABHI AAJ TAK NAHI TAALI
SABUT CHAHIYE ZALIM KO IS MOHABBAT KA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAN LETA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
KAFAN SE HATH NIKALE THE MERI DAADI NE
WHO GHAR KI BAAT THI ULFATH KEY BHI TAQQAZE THE
MGAR YAHA PE SAKINA HAI PR PHIR YE JAFA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAN LETA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAMIM-E-KARBOLA PAR WO KARWATE LEGI
YE SUNKEY LAASH-E-ALAMDAR KAAMP UTHEGI
KHUDA KARE NA SUNE WO BAAT YE SAQQA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAN LETA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
MUJHE BHI APNE MASAHEB SUNAIYE BABA
JAALE HUE MERE DAAMAN MEIN AAIYE BABA
SITAM HAI AAJ TAMASHAAI BANGAYI DUNIYA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAN LETA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
MILE JO AJRE RISALATH BATAOUNGI TUMKO
GALE PE NEEL RASAN KEY DIKHAOUNGI TUMKO
MUSIBATAO SE GUZARTA HAI BACHPANA MERA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAN LETA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
MOHABBATAON KA TAKALLUM YE MOUJIZA DEKHO
SARE HUSSAIN SAKINA KI GOUD MEIN AYA
NA AAYI BAALI SAKINA KEY PHIR LABOU PE SADA
<<MINI>>
YAZID AAJ MERA IMTEHAN LETA HAI
